newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to stay out of open market.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to stay out of open market.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to refrain from open market operations on Friday, analysts said.
"There's a small add need of about $2.0 billion a day which (the Fed) will probably start to address next week," said James Glassman, senior economist at Chase Securities Inc.
Glassman said the Treasury's balance at the Fed should be restored to normal after the paydown of some cash management bills that came due on Thursday.
Federal funds were trading at 5-3/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate, in morning dealings.
